notes.text: The named suspect reading is present in the checked Bavli, which calls him Rabbi Zeira bar Mammal in the objection. Heilprin's heading expands Rav. Preserve the reported heading and the primary text variant.
The material supports separate names in a comparable discussion. It does not establish the proposed repair in Kiddushin. The directly spoken utterance in the gloss needs its separate target.

Abba bar Mammal asks the question in Chullin and Zeira responds to the discussion, including a plural address. Kiddushin 9b contains an independent objection by Rabbi Abba bar Mammal. Neither warrants changing the distinct attribution of 9a.
